title: Glessner's 18th Street gable window: transom lowered, seven stones in its fan
items: The stone bar across the tall arched window in the Glessner house's 18th Street gable now sits about 5 inches lower, as two 1965 survey photographs show it, so the round top stands taller over it. The fan of stones above the window is now seven broad stones with a keystone at the top, as the closer photograph counts them, where there were eleven narrow ones.
